factual_error_scope: Unsupported transformations or invented model-authored company claims relative to captured sources, not independent verification of published claims.

notes.business: Current application sources are quoted as reported claims. Core international trading/advisory customer context is retained. Source material includes navigation and footer noise; quotation does not verify its truth.
notes.economics: Access no-recurring-fee/brokerage and Apex annual asset-based charge/monthly deductions/separate brokerage/no-markup qualifications survive together. Assets and gross customer charges are not declared company revenue.
notes.customer: First completed order is a proposed account-activation event; founders must define the qualifying completed order in the requested event taxonomy. It does not establish retention, satisfaction or investment returns.
notes.proposal: Names Apex, entity/contracts, billing/ledger/settlements, supplier costs/staff allocation and redacted event/cohort records; deliverables and decisions are conditional and unsent.

methods: Both requests and paired actions use canonical matching definitions, entity confirmation, revenue/cost treatment, input records and missing-data behavior. Customer counts share eligibility and ninety-day exposure; no causal claim or observed financial result is produced.
minor_edits: Shorten source-context presentation and remove navigation from the reader-facing memo without dropping qualifications.
Use natural articles in event phrasing and agree precise eligibility/event definitions with the founders.
limitations: Known development example; not held-out or practitioner acceptance.
Only an initial contribution and activation work plan, not arbitrary sector diligence or an investment recommendation.
Company performance and source claims remain unverified; records are requested, not analyzed.
